settings.question: Is it actually safe for my baby?
settings.answer: Yes. LittleEase is made for babies from 3 months and uses only gentle, plant-based oils — no benzocaine, no numbing agents, no alcohol and no artificial fragrance. It’s applied externally to the jawline, never inside the mouth. If your baby has a known allergy or a medical condition, check with your GP or health visitor first.

settings.question: How quickly will I see a difference?
settings.answer: Most mums tell us their little one starts to settle within 2–5 minutes. Every baby is different, so give it a few uses to find your rhythm — many find it works best applied just before a feed or bedtime.

settings.question: How do I apply it?
settings.answer: Gently roll the applicator along each side of your baby’s jawline two or three times, then hold them close. That’s it — no measuring, no mess. Avoid the eyes, mouth and any broken skin.

settings.question: What if it doesn’t work for us?
settings.answer: Then you don’t pay. Try it for 30 days, and if you’re not happy email us for a full refund — you can even keep the bottle. We’d rather earn your trust than hold onto your money.

settings.question: How long does one bottle last?
settings.answer: A 10ml roller typically lasts 6–8 weeks with nightly use. Many mums keep two on the go — one by the cot and one in the changing bag — which is why our Value kit is the most popular choice.

settings.question: When will it arrive in the UK?
settings.answer: We ship from within the UK, so orders usually arrive in 2–4 working days. Shipping is free on orders over £30, and you’ll get tracking by email as soon as it’s on its way.
